proposed_delta: FRANK C6 should instantiate the one-Clay-semantic-world target over UD-RC1 rather than assume a universal physical database. Exact state, events, effect/outcome receipts and causal replay form the authoritative spine; ClayGraph/vector/FTS/activation/Assembly are derived or transient planes with versioned receipts; capabilities/secrets remain hard isolated.

new_runtime_mechanism.name: Cognitive State Continuity Loop
sequence: sparse activation update between model calls
new_runtime_mechanism.expected_benefit: Memory can influence what FRANK considers next without an explicit retrieval-tool decision being required for every useful association.
new_runtime_mechanism.safety_boundary: Automatic activation supplies candidates/salience only; exact facts/effects still require typed anchors, selection receipts, current basis and capability authorization.

recommended_module_changes: Add UnifiedQueryIR/physical planner below Clay semantic contracts and above store adapters.
Add durable DerivationLog/Outbox tied to authoritative event IDs.
Add DerivedViewReceipt containing source epochs, derivation semantics, lag/freshness and rebuild recipe.
Extend CognitiveEpoch/MOSAIC capsule with physical-route/selection-plan identities only when operation-relevant.
Allow background activation maintenance between model calls behind a feature gate.
Keep explicit memory search as fallback/exact-validation path.
Keep K0/capability gateway as sole effect release authority.
do_not_do: Do not move secrets/capabilities into ordinary cognitive storage merely for unification.
Do not make activation/vector similarity/FTS rank canonical truth.
Do not require every FRANK subsystem epoch to be globally equal for every operation.
Do not claim cross-engine atomicity that the physical engines do not provide.
Do not physically merge stores until target workload/crash/recovery evidence beats the hybrid baseline.
priority_experiments: FRANK twin: no-memory vs explicit retrieval vs Cognitive State Continuity at matched token budget
fault injection across authoritative commit/outbox/graph/vector/FTS updates
selection-plan attack with authentic records and changed candidate membership
evidence_boundary: Architecture feedback based on current RAE results, external systems evidence and local synthetic database experiments; no live production promotion.
